coder_notes: Single-arm trial of O6-benzylguanine (MGMT inhibitor) with dose-escalated temozolomide protected by P140K-MGMT gene-modified stem cells (excluded cell/gene therapy type). BG is the only pharmacological investigational agent, so experimental_monotherapy. Temozolomide coded established_therapy_experiment because dose escalation is the question; carmustine given as 'SOC chemotherapy' with no stated schedule change, coded soc_backbone (could instead be part of the escalation). MGMT unmethylated requirement coded candidate_matched because the candidate (BG) directly targets MGMT. Endpoints on P140K-MGMT cell detection concern the cell product, not BG target engagement, so target_engagement_planned is no.
